brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

requirements.evidence: 7 full hex bases at 0,0 center plus 6 neighbors (-1,0; -1,1; 0,-1; 0,1; 1,-1; 1,0) forming complete honeycomb, connected with 12 side-connector-double on all interior edges
7 top covers: cover:-1,0,0;full;top, cover:-1,1,0;full;top, cover:0,-1,0;full;top, cover:0,0,0;full;top, cover:0,1,0;full;top, cover:1,-1,0;full;top, cover:1,0,0;full;top — one per cell

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge finished with caps
requirements.evidence: 18 solid caps on all exterior faces: 3 per outer cell at bearings 90/150/210 etc.; check_build reports 0 OPEN_CAP_FACE issues and meshClash clear

finish.summary: Seven-cell honeycomb at level 0 verified: 7 bases, 7 top covers, 18 perimeter caps, 12 interior connectors. check_build ok true, meshClash clear.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
